nodes.label: Low-Volatility, Steady-Compounding Strategy Profile
nodes.rationale: The figure is used as the project's showcase result: a near-monotonic 35-year equity curve rising 100k to ~590k with only 6.69% annual volatility and a 19.42% max drawdown. The chart is drawn on a logarithmic value axis so constant compounding reads as a straight line rather than a hockey stick, and the metrics table is placed directly beneath the curve so a reader judges the shape and the risk numbers together instead of being impressed by the curve alone. The modest 5.00% annual return paired with a 0.76 Sharpe signals the toolbox is demonstrating risk-adjusted, diversified backtesting rather than advertising outsized returns.
